node.statement: The external lem-extcb-one-dimensional-product supplies universal C_PQR<infinity and e_PQR>0, and lem-extcb-one-dimensional-corner-dimension supplies a universal threshold e_dim>0 for its sufficiently-small hypothesis. After enlarging C_PQR to at least 1, define e_sim=min{e_PQR/2,e_dim/2,1/(4*C_PQR)}. Then e_sim>0, and t<=e_sim implies e:=t+t=2t<=e_PQR, e<=e_dim, and C_PQR*e<=1/2.
